test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

One has to be persistent in studies if he/she wants to get his/her dream job. Success will remain unattainable if one studies ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **by fits and starts.**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• “**By fits and starts**” is an **idiom** that means “**without continuous/rigorous effort **or **“spasmodically”**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The way he studies by fits and starts; he will not score good marks.​*
 
 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• The **three R’s** stands for **three basic skills at school, reading, writing and arithmetic**.

 
 
• **Example**- *While teaching a student, the teacher should first concentrate on three R’s.*
 
 
 
• “**Root and branch**” is an idiom that means **completely.**
 
 
• **Example**- *American education and culture had changed him root and branch*.
 
 
 
• “**In ups and downs**” is an idiom that means "in **good and bad times**”.
 
 
• **Example: ***He was always with me in my ups and downs.*
